Parashari.description: The supreme foundational authority for natal astrology (Jathagam).

Jaimini.description: High authority, particularly for Dasha rules and Karakamsha.

Bhrigu_Naadi.description: Anecdotal and observational but highly accurate point predictions.

Prashna.description: Authority for horary/question-based astrology, heavily caveated for natal.

Modern_Specialized.description: Modern interpretations and remedies. Defers to classical texts in conflicts.

resolution_rules.conflict_resolution: In case of contradictory effects for the same trigger, calculate the sum of weights of the citing books. The rule with the highest total weight becomes the primary canonical rule.
resolution_rules.tie_breaker: If weights are equal, prioritize the rule citing a Parashari text.
